_comment: HashHedge ticker -> Bybit symbol override (used for BOTH spot-price and linear-perp resolution). Most HashHedge tickers are {SYMBOL}USDT on Bybit by default; this file only lists cases where that's wrong. The high-supply memecoins below resolve to their 1000x linear perp, so both price and funding/OI come from the perp — harmless because the strategy is scale-invariant (RSI/returns/ATR are all ratio-based), and the perp is the only tradeable instrument for these anyway.
